title.en: An Act Establishing in the Municipality of Liloan, Province of Cebu, a Children\rquote s Hospital to Be Known as the Liloan Children\rquote s Hospital and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing in the Municipality of Liloan, Province of Cebu, a Children\rquote s Hospital to Be Known as the Liloan Children\rquote s Hospital and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11886_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established in the Municipality of Liloan, Province of Cebu, a children’s hospital to be known as the Liloan Children’s Hospital (LCH), which shall be under the direct control and supervision of the Provincial Government of Cebu.

The hospital shall specialize in children’s health care services from prenatal to pediatrics care and nutrition counselling services, immunization, and training classes on children’s health for parents.

Any future increase in bed capacity, health care facilities, service capability, and human resource complement shall be based on the hospital development plan which shall be prepared by the Chief of Hospital of the LCH, in consultation with the Department of Health (DOH).

The Provincial Government of Cebu shall provide the necessary funds for the establishment of the LCH. The Secretary of Health shall include in the Department’s subsidy program, support for the capital outlay requirements of the LCH.
All laws, executive orders, issuances, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Act are hereby modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
